name: p9_coupled_division
title: Biohub P9 Coupled Division
purpose: Atomic transplant of the public 0.926 lineage's coupled safe-division mechanism onto deployed P3 harmonic (LB 0.915): widen parent/sister/existing-child radii together to 8/11/10 um, require a mid-track parent, retain only the linked child's cKDTree-nearest orphan sister, and require both daughters to continue to t+2 with separation growth >=2.25 um. Detection, harmonic association, checkpoints, ILP, relinking, gap closing, DeepCenter state, short-track policy, caps, and submission format stay exactly P3. P3's in<=1/out<=2 guards are retained and the override checks degrees immediately after admission. No launch or submission is performed by this spec.

provenance.base: deployed P3 harmonic built notebook, sha256 70b636b64455f5fd24caa7ffbed661c43003f64764ba77f8768f8f53f9380ca8, public LB 0.915
provenance.public_function_identity: The complete 150-line add_safe_divisions_postlink function is byte-identical in both downloaded public notebooks. Full code differs only by blank-line whitespace at four positions.
provenance.routes_on: graph topology and physical node coordinates only; no dataset, crop, acquisition, hidden label, or image-content routing
provenance.interaction_warning: The three radii and C1/C2/C3 filters are one coupled treatment. Do not ablate or submit C3 alone; local GT shows that would discard about half of true divisions. The P3 harmonic association surface can change which nodes are orphans, so the public +0.013 is evidence for the mechanism family, not a guaranteed additive delta on P3.
